# Cactus Wren Dental

> Family and cosmetic dental office in Arcadia, Phoenix, Arizona. Gentle care for kids and adults, a free 3D smile preview, prices shown up front, most PPO plans, and a membership plan for patients without insurance. English and Spanish spoken.

Note: this is a concept project made for a portfolio. The practice, team, reviews and prices are fictional, and phone numbers use the fictional 555-01xx range. Designed and built by Slobodan Dabic (https://sdabic.com).

## Contact
- Phone: (602) 555-0163
- WhatsApp: https://wa.me/16025550163
- Location: Camelback Rd & 44th St, Phoenix, AZ 85018 (Arcadia). Free covered parking.
- Hours: Mon–Thu 7:00 AM–5:00 PM, Fri 7:00 AM–2:00 PM, Sat 8:00 AM–12:00 PM, Sun closed. Arizona time (no daylight saving).
- Online booking: https://cactus-dental.slobodan.workers.dev/#book

## Services and self-pay prices
- New patient exam, full X-rays and cleaning: $99 (regularly $310)
- Kids' visit: $85. Children seen from their first tooth (around age one).
- In-office teeth whitening: $450. Custom take-home trays: $295.
- Invisalign clear aligners: from $3,900, starting with a free 3D scan.
- Tooth-colored fillings: from $180. Same-day crowns: $1,290.
- Dental implant with crown: $3,600.
- Sedation: nitrous oxide $75, oral sedation available.
- Emergency exam: $95. Call before 2 pm for a same-day visit.

## 3D smile preview (free)
1. Scan: a two-minute intraoral scan, with no impression material and no radiation.
2. See: the teeth appear in 3D on a screen at the chair; the dentist explains what they see.
3. Preview: whitening, veneers or Invisalign results shown on the patient's own scan (for example shade A3 to B1).
4. Price: a written quote with the insurance share before any treatment starts.

## Insurance
- In-network: Delta Dental PPO, Cigna Dental PPO, Aetna Dental PPO, MetLife PDP, Guardian PPO, United Concordia, Blue Cross Blue Shield of Arizona.
- Out-of-network but accepted: Humana Dental, Ameritas. Claims are filed for the patient.
- HMO / DHMO plans are not accepted.

## Wren Smile Plan (no insurance)
- Adult: $29/month or $299/year. Child (under 14): $19/month or $199/year.
- Includes 2 cleanings and exams per year, all routine X-rays and 1 emergency exam. Adults get 15% off fillings, crowns and implants; children get fluoride and sealants.
- No deductibles, waiting periods or claim forms.

## Payment
Cash, all major cards, HSA/FSA, CareCredit and Sunbit (0% financing over $500 for qualified patients).

## Team
- Dr. Elena Márquez, DDS: founder, family and cosmetic dentistry, 14 years in practice, English and Spanish.
- Dr. Omar Haddad, DMD: implants and oral surgery.
- Dr. Ben Whitaker, DMD: orthodontics and Invisalign.
- Lina Tran, RDH: lead dental hygienist.

## FAQ
- First visit: bring a photo ID, insurance card and a list of medications. New patient forms can be filled out online.
- Nervous patients: extra time, noise-cancelling headphones, weighted blanket, nitrous oxide or oral sedation; raise a hand to pause at any time.
- Spanish: yes, Dr. Márquez and much of the team speak Spanish.
